'''Rogério Cezar de Cerqueira Leite''' (14 July 1931 – 1 December 2024) was a Brazilian physicist and engineer.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://fapesp.br/17284/morre-rogerio-cezar-de-cerqueira-leite|title=Morre Rogério Cezar de Cerqueira Leite|website=fapesp.br}}</ref> He died in [[Campinas]], São Paulo on 1 December 2024, at the age of 93.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://g1.globo.com/sp/campinas-regiao/noticia/2024/12/01/cientista-rogerio-cerqueira-leite-morre-aos-93-anos.ghtml|title=Rogério Cerqueira Leite, um dos maiores cientistas brasileiros, morre aos 93 anos|date=December 1, 2024|website=G1}}</ref>
